verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports describe a Snowflake free trial on the Standard plan where the user loaded about 40GB of data and ran real queries in Snowsight, so a self-serve trial with real workloads exists. The evidence does not establish that it needs no credit card or no sales contact, and first-party docs only describe consumption-based pricing and an entry-level Standard edition, not trial terms. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the free trial and its limits, evidence that no credit card is required, evidence that no sales call is required.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can evaluate with a free tier or trial — real queries on real data without a credit card or a sales call

citations.quote: On the free trial (standard plan, AWS US East), the author used 9 credits and 40GB of storage, about $19.60 of resources.
Since the beginning of my trial, I have used 9 credits and 40GB of storage
Snowsight, Snowflake's preview app, let the author both query and visualize the data for the blog post's charts.
